texts.preamble: S N Consultant vs Deputy Commissioner Of Customs & Anr on 5 November, 2024 Author: Vibhu Bakhru Bench: Vibhu Bakhru, Swarana Kanta Sharma $~10 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi + W.P.(C) 7728/2024 S N Consultant Th ve Deputy Commissioner Of Customs & Anr.... Through: Mr Aditya Singla, S Counsel with Mr Rit Medha Navani, Advoc Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vibhu Bakhru Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma Or % 05.11.2024 1.
texts.facts: The petitioner has filed the present petition, inter alia, praying as under: "(a) To direct the respondents to release the goods without bank guarantee (b) To Direct the Respondent no.1 to re-sample the goods covering under Bill of Entry of Entry No 2197904 Dated 19.02.2024 as per the FSSAI Act; (c) Pass such other order or orders as may be deemed fit ad proper in the interest of justice." 2. The petitioner is engaged in import and trading of areca nuts and had imported a consignment of the said goods on 12.01.2024. The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2024 at 21:26:56 was generated by the Custom Department on 19.02.2024. However, the goods were not released pending verification of the certificate of the country of origin. The petitioner being aggrieved on account of non-release of the goods has filed the present petition. While the present proceedings were pending, samples of the goods were drawn and were sent for testing. Mr. Singla, learned counsel appearing for the respondent, has drawn our attention to a communication dated 12 July 2024 addressed to the authorized officer of the National Food Laboratory, Food Safety & Standards Authority of India and in terms of which a request has been made to the said authority to designate an officer who may draw samples as per the request of the petitioner which has come to be accepted. Thereafter, at a hearing held on 25.09.2024, this Court was informed that the goods had been examined by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).
texts.arguments: 5. Mr Aditya Singla, learned counsel, appearing for the respondents submits that an order has been passed and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) for the consignment covered under Bill of Entry No.2197904 dated 19.02.2024 has been granted.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 5. Mr Aditya Singla, learned counsel, appearing for the respondents submits that an order has been passed and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) for the consignment covered under Bill of Entry No.2197904 dated 19.02.2024 has been granted.
